summary: TPG Private Equity Opportunities, L.P. filed an 8-K under Items 3.02 (unregistered sales of equity securities) and 8.01 (other events, updating transactional NAV methodology). The filing reports a routine continuous private offering: on July 1, 2026, the fund issued multiple classes of limited partnership units (Class I, D, S, F) for aggregate consideration of $84.4 million, exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D. The disclosure describes the fund structure and valuation process used to set transaction prices. This is an ordinary capital raising activity, not a special situation. No terms (price per unit, premium) are stated. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC action, or forced management change.
